name: Short Cut Sriracha Chicken Salad Sandwich with Avocado & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken and mayo in a small bowl. Stir to combine the chicken salad, then season with salt and pepper to taste (if desired).
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g cooked chicken (shredded)
⅓ cup sriracha mayonnaise
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed). Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and thinly slice.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Layer the bottom half of each bun with spinach, chicken salad, and avocado. Close sandwiches with remaining top of each bun.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
